css_token_system.impl: Add --ts: 1 to :root. All font-size: calc(VALpx * var(--ts)). Reduce --ts at breakpoints.

index_hover_preview.desc: Left panel project numbers — hover shows preview image above the list

96px_collapsed_tab.desc: writing-mode: vertical-rl + rotate(180deg) for rotated tab text in 96px column

dennissnellenberg_com.stack: jQuery + GSAP 3.9.1 + ScrollTrigger + Barba.js + Locomotive Scroll + Kirby CMS
dennissnellenberg_com.font: PP Neue Montreal (renamed Dennis Sans) — use Satoshi (free) or keep Inter

oversized_horizontal_name.desc: h1 at 288px, 2780px wide. Wrapped in div with data-scroll-direction=horizontal data-scroll-speed=4. Locomotive Scroll drives it left on page scroll.
oversized_horizontal_name.impl_vanilla: On window scroll, read scrollY, apply transform: translateX(-scrollY * 0.4) to .hero-name wrapper. Clamp to avoid overscroll. Duplicate text node for seamless loop.
oversized_horizontal_name.our_version: Use name as oversized h1, overlay it behind the left panel. It slides right-to-left as user scrolls into projects. Font: EB Garamond 600 italic for identity feel.

preloader.desc: Multilingual hello words cycle, then fade out
preloader.our_version: Cycle thematic words instead: absent — present — forgotten — remembered — nonexistent — here. Last word: HERE. Then fade. Tie to sessionStorage so it only plays once per session.

mouse_follow_image.desc: position:fixed 475x475 card centered on cursor. GSAP lerps a bounce wrapper. Blue View pill follows separately.
mouse_follow_image.impl: requestAnimationFrame lerp: target.x += (mouse.x - target.x) * 0.08. Card shows project screenshot. Pill uses accent color --you (#c9704a). Show on .pindex hover OR project list hover.

rounded_div_section_break.desc: overflow:hidden wrapper + border-radius:50% div at 2880px wide = curved section edge
rounded_div_section_break.impl: Add .arc-break divs between sections. Dark-to-light and light-to-dark transitions.
rounded_div_section_break.our_version: Use between projects section and about section. Color shift: deep void black curves into slightly lighter bg-raised.

line_mask_reveal.desc: span.span-line { overflow:hidden } + span.span-line-inner { transform: translateY(110%) } → 0 on IntersectionObserver
line_mask_reveal.impl: Already have .reveal class — upgrade it to split-line mask. Split h2/h3 by line using a JS splitter on DOMContentLoaded.
line_mask_reveal.our_version: Apply to section headings. Stagger delay per line via CSS --d var.

magnetic_buttons.desc: mousemove proximity detection, GSAP lerp button toward cursor
magnetic_buttons.impl_vanilla: On mousemove, check if within threshold (100px). Lerp button translate toward cursor at 0.3 strength. Reset on mouseleave.

work_list_typography.desc: Big project names (100px+) full-width, category tag right-aligned, hairline separator
work_list_typography.our_version: Use this pattern for the left-panel project index. Name in Garamond, stack tags in mono at 11px uppercase.

layout.side: position:sticky, top:0, width: clamp(280px, 30vw, 420px), height:100vh, overflow:hidden, flex col

new_components_to_build.name: Preloader
new_components_to_build.file: main.js — add preloader() fn, call before init()
new_components_to_build.behavior: Each word fades in translateY(0) from translateY(20px), then fades out. Last word 'here' holds 600ms. Whole screen fades out. sessionStorage flag prevents replay.

new_components_to_build.name: Oversized scrolling name
new_components_to_build.html: YOUR NAME — YOUR NAME —
new_components_to_build.css: .name-track { position:fixed; bottom: 15vh; left:0; width:100%; overflow:hidden; pointer-events:none; z-index:0 } .name-scroll { display:block; white-space:nowrap; font: 600 italic clamp(80px, 14vw, 180px)/1 'EB Garamond', serif; color: var(--text-ghost); will-change: transform }

new_components_to_build.name: Mouse-follow project card
new_components_to_build.css: .hover-card { position:fixed; width:380px; height:240px; pointer-events:none; z-index:999; opacity:0; transition:opacity 0.3s; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) } .hover-pill { position:fixed; background:var(--you); color:#fff; border-radius:99px; padding:8px 20px; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; pointer-events:none; z-index:1000; opacity:0; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) }
new_components_to_build.js: rAF lerp card position. Show on .pindex li hover, hide on mouseleave. Set card bg-image to project.image.

new_components_to_build.name: Arc section breaks
new_components_to_build.css: .arc-break { overflow:hidden; height:100px; position:relative } .arc-break--down .arc-div { width:200vw; height:200vw; border-radius:50%; position:absolute; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); bottom:0; background:var(--bg-raised) } .arc-break--up .arc-div { top:0 }

new_components_to_build.name: Line-mask text reveal
new_components_to_build.file: main.js — add splitLines() fn, style.css — add .line-wrap/.line-inner
new_components_to_build.css: .line-wrap { overflow:hidden; display:block } .line-inner { display:block; transform:translateY(110%); opacity:0; transition: transform var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out), opacity var(--dur-slow) } .line-inner.in { transform:translateY(0); opacity:1 }
new_components_to_build.js: IntersectionObserver on .reveal-lines elements. On intersect, add .in to each .line-inner with staggered delay.
